code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
                objs.append((c0,color,cells,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1,r0,c0))
    objs.sort()
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; rr=cc=0
    for i,(_,color,cells,oh,ow,r0,c0) in enumerate(objs):
        for y,x in cells:
            Y=rr+y-r0; X=cc+x-c0
            if 0<=Y<h and 0<=X<w: out[Y][X]=color
        rr += oh-1; cc += ow-1
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
